title.narrative: Strengthening Protection and Shelter Strategies in Venezuela to mitigate the risks associated to Human Trafficking

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to provide Protection and Shelter and Non-Food Items assistance to people affected by negative socioeconomic conditions and climate change in Amazoas, Apure and Sucre Regions. This UNHCR project strengthens the protection of Human Trafficking and GVB Survivors. The project provides humanitarian assistance to 5,249 people, including 2,100 women, 1,680 men, 1,469 children, and including 525 persons with disabilities.
